nodes.label: postcss >=8.5.10 Security Override
nodes.rationale: Forces the patched postcss everywhere (GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93: XSS in stringified output <8.5.10) because next and next-auth's transitive next still pin older; applying it required pnpm dedupe since plain pnpm install short-circuits and doesn't apply new overrides.
